# Three.js 0.160.1

Locally vendored browser ES module for Playgrid's actual 3D Mini Golf renderer.
Loaded only when Mini Golf mounts; there is no runtime CDN request or additional server package.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.1/build/three.module.min.js
SHA-256: `3e690ac7d180b0aadf0891bea39eec643e29e2d3e75c99b18689518665f69ba6`
License: MIT, retained verbatim in LICENSE and in the module's license notice.
The course models, textures, UI, interaction code and game rules are Playgrid code, not publisher assets.
